title: Time Management
summary: Time management means prioritising and planning. Useful techniques include to-do lists ranked by importance, time-blocking, the Pomodoro technique (25 minutes work, 5 minutes break) and starting with a tiny first step.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
